summary: 从以肉食获取盐，到农业社会主动寻找盐源，再到现代开采岩盐和提炼卤水，制盐技术随着饮食、气候与用途改变。食用盐、道路融雪盐和科研用盐各有纯度要求。
logic: 饮食变化催生取盐需求
日晒、钻井和加热因地制宜
岩盐开采与卤水提炼分流

paragraphs.brief: 盐还用于无数其他用途，如清除道路中的雪和冰、软化水、保存食物和稳定土壤以用于建筑。
sentences: Salt is the common name for the substance sodium chloride (NaCl), which occurs in the form of transparent cubic crystals.
盐是氯化钠物质(NaCl)的共同名称，以透明立方晶体的形式出现。
Although salt is most familiar as a food supplement, less than 5% of the salt produced worldwide is used for that purpose.
虽然盐是最熟悉的食品补充，但全世界生产的盐中只有不到5%用于这一目的。
About 70% is utilized by the chemical industry, mostly as a source of chlorine.
化学工业使用70%左右，大部分用作氯的来源。
Salt is also used for countless other purposes, such as removing snow and ice from roads, softening water, preserving food, and stabilizing soils for construction.
盐还用于无数其他用途，如清除道路中的雪和冰、软化水、保存食物和稳定土壤以用于建筑。

paragraphs.brief: 最早的人类从天然盐浓度和肉类中获得了盐。
sentences: The earliest humans obtained their salt from natural salt concentrations, as well as from meat.
最早的人类从天然盐浓度和肉类中获得了盐。
Those people who lived near the ocean may also have obtained it by chewing seaweed or from the natural evaporation of small pools of seawater.
生活在海洋附近的人们也可能通过咀嚼海藻或从小海水池的自然蒸发而获得海藻。
Meat became a more important source of salt as hunting was developed, as did milk when sheep, goats, horses, camels, reindeer, and cattle were domesticated.
肉类成为了更重要的盐源，因为狩猎和奶制品都是由羊、山羊、马、骆驼、驯鹿和牛饲养的。
Even today, certain peoples—such as the Bedouin of the Middle Eastern deserts and the Maasai of East Africa—use no other forms of salt.
即使在今天，某些民族——例如中东沙漠的贝都因人和东非的马赛人——也不再使用其他形式的盐。

paragraphs.brief: 随着农业的发展，导致主要由植物组成的饮食，因此有必要制定办法，以更大数量获取盐。
sentences: As agriculture developed, leading to a diet consisting mostly of plants, it became necessary to devise ways of obtaining salt in greater amounts.
随着农业的发展，导致主要由植物组成的饮食，因此有必要制定办法，以更大数量获取盐。
The earliest method of salt production employed by humankind was the evaporation of seawater using the heat of the sun.
人类最早采用的盐生产方法是利用太阳的热量蒸发海水。
This method was particularly suited to hot, arid regions near the ocean or near salty lakes, and is still used in those areas.
这一方法特别适合海洋附近或盐湖附近热、干旱地区，而且仍在这些地区使用。
Solar evaporation was soon followed by the quarrying of exposed masses of rock salt, which quickly developed into the mining of underground deposits of salt.
在太阳蒸发之后，不久又采石采石，大量暴露的岩石盐迅速发展成地下盐矿。
Two thousand years ago, the Chinese began using wells to reach underground pools of salt water, some of which were more than one kilometer deep.
两千年前，中国人开始使用水井进入地下盐水池，有些水池深达一公里以上。

paragraphs.brief: 在气候不允许太阳蒸发的地区，将盐水倒在燃烧的木材上或加热的岩石上煮。
sentences: In areas where the climate did not allow solar evaporation, salt water was poured on burning wood or heated rocks to boil it.
在气候不允许太阳蒸发的地区，将盐水倒在燃烧的木材上或加热的岩石上煮。
The salt left behind was then scraped off.
剩下的盐被刮掉。
During the time of the Roman Empire, shallow lead pans were used to boil salt water over open fires to extract the salt.
在罗马帝国时期，浅铅锅被用来在开阔的火灾中煮盐水，以提取盐。
Later, in the Middle Ages, these were replaced with iron pans which were heated with coal.
后来，在中世纪，用铁锅取代了铁锅，用煤加热。
In the 1860s, a procedure known as the Michigan process was invented, in which salt water was heated by steam running through pipes immersed in the water.
在1860年代，发明了一种叫做密歇根过程的程序，在这种程序中，盐水被蒸汽通过浸入水中的管子加热。
This process is still used to produce certain types of salt.
这一工艺仍然用于生产某些种类的盐。

paragraphs.brief: 如今，盐来自两个来源：岩石盐和盐。
sentences: Nowadays, salt is collected from two sources: rock salt and brine.
如今，盐来自两个来源：岩石盐和盐。
Rock salt is simply crystallized salt, also known as halite.
石盐只是结晶盐也称为青石棉
It is the result of the evaporation of ancient oceans millions of years ago.
这是数百万年前古代海洋蒸发的结果。
Underground salt deposits are usually discovered by prospectors searching for water or oil.
探矿者通常会发现地下盐矿，寻找水或石油。
When salt is detected, a diamond-tipped, hollow drill is used to take several regularly spaced core samples throughout the area.
在检测到盐时，用钻头进行空心钻探，在整个地区采集几个定期间隔的岩芯样品。
These are analyzed to determine if salt mining would be profitable.
对这些分析是为了确定盐矿开采是否有利可图。
If the site is thought to be suitable, vertical tunnels are sunk into the center of the salt deposit.
如果该矿址被认为是合适的，垂直隧道就会沉入盐矿中央。
Then a machine resembling a gigantic chain saw is used to cut a long horizontal slot through the salt, in a procedure known as undercutting.
然后用一个像巨型链锯的机器在盐中切开一个长的水平槽，其程序被称为下层。
A series of holes are then drilled into the salt with an electric drill, and the holes are filled with explosives such as dynamite.
然后用电钻将一系列孔钻入盐中，洞里装满炸药等炸药。
Cutting and blasting are repeated in a pattern that leaves salt pillars standing to support the roof of the mining area.
切割和爆破反复出现，使盐柱站立，支撑矿区屋顶。
This is known as the room-and-pillar method and is also used in coal mines.
这种方法被称为室柱法，也用于煤矿。
Once blasted, chunks of the rock salt are transported to an underground crushing area where smaller pieces are collected via a metal grill and larger pieces are crushed in a rotating cylinder.
一旦爆炸，岩石盐块块将运到一个地下粉碎区，通过金属烤箱收集较小块块，大块块块被一个旋转的圆筒压碎。
Finally, redundant matter is extracted from the rock salt, in what is known as picking.
最后，从岩石盐中提取了多余物质，也就是所谓的采摘。

paragraphs.brief: 盐水沸腾蒸汽进入下一个气瓶
sentences: Brine is water containing a high concentration of salt.
Brine是含高浓度盐的水。
The most obvious source of brine is the ocean, but it can also be obtained from salty lakes such as the Dead Sea and from underground pools of salt water.
最明显的盐水来源是海洋，但也可以从死海等盐湖和地下盐水池中获取。
Most brine is processed by a multi-effect vacuum evaporator.
大部分盐都是用多效真空蒸发器处理的。
This device consists of three or more closed metal cylinders.
该装置由三个或三个以上封闭的金属圆筒组成。
Brine is first treated to remove chemical compounds.
Brine首先被处理去掉化学化合物。
It then fills the bottom of the cylinders.
然后填满气瓶底部。
The brine in the first cylinder passes through tubes heated by steam.
第一个气瓶的盐水通过蒸汽加热的管子。
The brine boils and its steam enters the next cylinder.
盐水沸腾蒸汽进入下一个气瓶
In each cylinder, the condensation of steam causes the pressure inside to drop.
每个气瓶的蒸气凝结都会让气压下降
A material called slurry forms at the bottom of the cylinders and goes into a tank.
一种叫做泥浆的材料在气瓶底部形成，进入一个罐体。
The slurry is then filtered to remove excess brine, dried, and passed through screens to sort the salt particles according to how large they are.
然后对泥浆进行过滤，以去除多余的盐水，加以干燥，然后通过屏幕，根据盐粒的大小进行分类。

paragraphs.brief: 盐的规格因用途不同而大不相同。
sentences: Specifications for salt vary widely according to the intended use.
盐的规格因用途不同而大不相同。
Salt intended for human consumption must be much purer than salt used for melting snow and ice on roads, but salt used for certain scientific purposes may need to be even purer.
用于人类消费的盐必须比用于融雪的盐和用于道路冰的盐更纯净，但用于某些科学目的的盐可能需要更纯洁。

items.en: The chemical industry makes use of the majority of salt produced globally.
items.zh: 化学工业使用全球生产的大多数盐。
items.why: 化工业使用了约七成盐，超过全球产量的一半。

items.en: In ancient times, people were only able to get salt from a single source.
items.zh: 在古代人们只能从一个来源获得盐
items.why: 题干说“only…single source (只有单一来源)”,而原文列出多来源，与之矛盾，故 FALSE。

items.en: Salt production through quarrying rock salt was common before the solar evaporation method of producing salt.
items.zh: 在采用太阳能蒸发法生产盐之前，通过采石岩盐生产盐是常见的。
items.why: 原文明确“先日栖，后采掘",题干颠倒先后，故 FALSE。

items.en: Two thousand years ago, the Chinese were quick to develop the equipment needed to mine underground.
items.zh: 两千年前，中国人迅速开发了地下矿藏所需的设备
items.why: 原文只说“开始使用井”,并未评价“很快 (quick to develop)”这一速度/效率，信息缺失，故 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: At the time of the Roman Empire, salt was removed from salt water by heating the water in a type of pan.
items.zh: 在罗马帝国时期，人们把盐水放在一种浅锅里加热，以提取其中的盐。
items.why: 罗马帝国时期用浅铅锅在明火上煮盐水提盐，符合题干所述容器与加热方法。

items.en: during a process called ________, a machine is used to break into the salt
items.zh: 在名为________的工序中，工人用机器切入盐层。
items.why: 在名为6 的工序中，用机器切入盐层。

items.en: after blasting, ________ of salt are left behind to hold the roof up
items.zh: 爆破后要留下盐做的________，以支撑矿井顶板。
items.why: 爆破后，留上7 支撑顶板。

items.en: in an underground crushing area, small pieces of rock salt are gathered using a ________
items.zh: 在地下破碎区，细小的岩盐块通过一个________收集起来。
items.why: 地下破碎区用8 _ ”收集小块岩盐。

items.en: the process of ________ removes any unwanted material from the rock salt
items.zh: 通过________这道工序，可以去除岩盐中不需要的杂质。
items.why: 直接原词。表示“拣选/拣除杂质。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 第 1 段 · 第 2 句
第 3 段 · 第 5 句
points: 题干说“only…single source (只有单一来源)”,而原文列出多来源，与之矛盾，故 FALSE。
clauses: …, less than 5% of the salt produced worldwide is used for that purpose.
连接词 although 引出“Although salt is most familiar as a food supplement”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
“if salt mining would be profitable”补足 determine 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 determine 所在的主句，再把 if 后面的内容作为一个整体。
